what_is_closed: two linearized-GR transverse-traceless polarizations evolve on a finite non-periodic interval
Legendre-Gauss-Lobatto diagonal-norm SBP identity and polynomial derivative exactness pass
a constraint-compatible SAT penalty gives the exact semidiscrete energy rate minus the squared endpoint momenta
the TT reduction constraint is preserved and a right-going packet exits without a large reflected-energy remainder
a left-going analytic packet is independently absorbed at the opposite face

equation_or_mapping.tt_wave: partial_t^2 h_A - partial_x^2 h_A = 0, A in {+,x}
equation_or_mapping.sat: Pi_dot=-D G-H^-1 e_L*(Pi+G)_L-H^-1 e_R*(Pi-G)_R; G_dot=-D Pi; h_dot=-Pi
equation_or_mapping.semi_discrete_energy: E=1/2 sum_A (Pi_A^T H Pi_A + G_A^T H G_A)
equation_or_mapping.reduction_constraint: D h_A-G_A=0 is invariant under the semidiscrete evolution

major_result.derivation_class: standard linearized-GR TT wave equation plus directly verified SBP-SAT semidiscrete energy identity
major_result.observable: boundary flux, semidiscrete energy, reduction-constraint residual, and pulse remainders at both faces
major_result.data_role: manufactured analytic/synthetic numerical control; no source data, fitting, or holdout
open_blockers: the 4+2+4 constraint/physical/gauge decomposition is not imposed on the full ten-component GH system
positive-normal-shift incoming u2_A constraint conditions are not evolved
variable-coefficient nonlinear GH, corners, matter boundary conditions, and full subsidiary-constraint propagation remain untested
this pilot does not implement the full differential Rinne CPBC and does not modify the periodic GH solver
major_result.dependency_unlocked: none; this validates one standard-GR physical TT boundary sector only
major_result.claim_boundary: bounded linearized-GR TT-sector numerical control only; not full GH CPBC, nonlinear IBVP well-posedness, Einstein-equation derivation by UET, Gravity compatibility, or global UET closure

scope.equation_class: standard linearized-GR physical TT sector; not a new UET equation
scope.domain: finite one-dimensional slab [-1,1] with no periodic wraparound
scope.method: Legendre-Gauss-Lobatto collocation with diagonal-norm SBP and weak SAT boundary penalties
scope.boundary_data: homogeneous no-incoming TT characteristic data at both faces

numerical_policy.timestep: min(0.5 times minimum LGL spacing, 0.25 times the computed RK4 linear stability limit)
